verses.text: Why are the nations so angry? Why do the peoples make useless plans?
The kings of the earth get ready to fight, and the rulers plan together against the LORD and against his Anointed King. They say,
"Let's break their chains and throw off their ropes."
The one who sits on his throne in heaven laughs. The Lord makes fun of them.
Then he speaks to them in his anger and terrifies them in his fury.
He says, "I have put my King on Zion, my holy hill."
I will announce what the LORD has decided. He said to me, "You are my son. Today I have become your father.
Ask me, and I will give you the nations as your own, the farthest parts of the earth as your property.
You will break them with an iron rod. You will smash them to pieces like clay pots."
So now, you kings, be wise. Listen to this warning, you rulers of the earth.
Serve the LORD with respect and fear, and celebrate with trembling.
Bow down and honour the Son, or he will be angry and you will be destroyed on your way, because his anger can flare up quickly. Happy are all who go to him for safety.
